description: This script extracts the .config file from a kernel image, working only when the kernel was compiled with CONFIG_IKCONFIG. It identifies the embedded configuration data within the kernel image, handling compressed images via decompression tools.

methods.name: dump_config
methods.description: Extracts and outputs the configuration data from a kernel image if present.

methods.name: try_decompress
methods.description: Attempts to decompress the kernel image with different algorithms and then extract the config.
